text:
jamie: Urgent  hold on the Optimize embargo. Legal flagged a claim in the benchmark text that needs rewording. Do not publish or amplify until we confirm.

priya: Ack. What exact language?

legal-bot: Flagged phrase: "cost reductions of up to 10x". Requested change: use verified phrasing "up to 3x token throughput" and remove explicit cost multiplier since it varies by workload.

sam: We already had scheduled partner sends at 09:00 PT. Do we pull those?

jamie: Yes, pause partner sends and socials. Press outreach on hold. @press-bot cancel scheduled posts.

press-bot: Scheduled social posts cancelled (job_id=7721). Partner email queued canceled.

ana: Quick ask: has the blog already been pushed to CDN? I saw a live URL on a staging preview but not sure if it went public.

ben: The publish job did run but the CDN purge step is pending; if we stop now we can prevent public cache. I'll abort the final publish and revert the CDN change.

ben: Abort complete. No public cache entry created.

priya: Thanks. Legal - do we have approved replacement sentence we can use so we can reopen the embargo?

legal-bot: Approved replacement: "Our benchmark shows up to 3x token throughput improvements on the measured production workloads; performance and cost improvements vary by model and configuration. Methodology: https://redwood.com/assets/optimize/methodology-v1.2.pdf". This language must appear in both blog and partner materials.

jamie: Good. Sam, update partner bundle with the new sentence and re-run shortlinks.

sam: On it. I'll patch partner-copy.md and regenerate shortlinks. ETA 20 min.

priya: Also need a short, embeddable quote approved by the CEO for partners. Can someone draft and route quickly?

ben: Draft CEO quote: "Optimize gives teams predictable inference performance and clear levers to tune cost and latency in production." Approve?

legal-bot: Quote approved. Minimal edits allowed.

jamie: Great. Once sam confirms assets, we'll notify partners and resume embargo. Everyone watch this thread for the go/no-go.

sam: Partner bundle updated (gs://redwood-partners/optimize-bundle-v1.3). Shortlinks regenerated.

press-bot: Partner email re-queued: send_time=1809000600 job_id=7725

priya: Quick cross-check: research, can you confirm the methodology link references the exact testbed used? We had earlier comments about missing GPU type.

ana: Confirmed. Methodology v1.2 includes GPU and sequence length sections. I added a clarifying line on the GPU model names. Uploaded patch to assets.

jamie: OK team, final sanity check - blog text updated, partner bundle patched, CEO quote approved, shortlinks ready. Legal, please confirm we can resume the embargo schedule.

legal-bot: Legal confirms. Resume embargo schedule for 09:00 PT as planned. All materials must use the approved phrasing.

jamie: Resume notice posted. Please escalate any downstream deviations. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :heart:
